outcome: Give an Increment a real Git working copy inside the Runner's confinement, associate it with the Repository it belongs to, and repair the control target that is currently always empty, so a Requirement can reach a committed change on a branch.
non_goals: Do not push to any remote in this task
Do not make the Git working copy a domain contract
Do not let a working copy outlive the Increment that owns it

transitions.reason: the Repository registration design measured that no Go file operates a Git working copy, so decomposition reaches an Execution record and stops; it also measured that cmd/control-plane builds ServiceConfig without a RepositoryID, so ControlTarget.RepositoryID is always empty and a repository-scoped Control Intent can never match

the three stages reach nine components and the character of the verification changes at each boundary, from a deterministic local closure to a real kernel Git integration to a live forge record, so they are separate tasks rather than one
